verdict.rationale: Datalab's docs claim Marker "handles complex layouts, tables" and outputs Markdown/HTML, but a hands-on community report says many tables in an RPG rulebook came out "messed up", and the user had to fall back to ChatGPT for irregular tables. That is a concrete contradiction of the table-handling claim. missing for 10: documented handling of merged cells, documented handling of nested headers, documented handling of tables spanning multiple pages, independent evidence of faithful complex-table output.

support.subject: As a data engineer, complex tables — merged cells, nested headers, multi-page spans — come out as faithful HTML/markdown structure

citations.quote: Marker handles complex layouts, tables, math, and images.
